Effect: Once per long rest, when failing a Persuasion, Deception, or Negotiation check, you may reroll with advantage by adjusting your approach mid-conversation. This reflects human social adaptability and persistence.

(The universe is to be studied, not interfered with. Knowledge is its own reward.) - Core Benefits: +2 Arcana or Investigation, +1 Stealth, proficiency in Observation & Non-Intervention Tactics.

You gain the Debt Ledger ability: •You may record a favor, slight, or social contract once per day. •You may “call in” a ledgered favor once per week from a friendly NPC if it would make narrative sense. This could mean extra supplies, minor secrets, shelter, or temporary assistance. •Ledgered slights allow you to gain Advantage on a future Intimidation or Insight check involving the same individual or faction.
You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift. You have advantage on checks to resist being moved or knocked prone.

You gain a permanent +2 bonus to Insight checks to recall past social interactions, events, or betrayals involving other named characters or NPCs. Once per long rest, you may force a creature you've interacted with before to make a Charisma saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency + your Charisma modifier). On a failure, they hesitate, gaining Disadvantage on any action targeting you for 1 round. (This ability represents the Rog's deeply ingrained memory and their ability to unsettle others with it.)
When taking non-magical damage from environmental sources (heat, cold, debris, falling, etc.), reduce the total damage taken by 2 (minimum 1). At Tier 3 or higher, this increases to 4.

You have Advantage on saving throws against being frightened. In addition, once per long rest, if you would fall to 0 HP from an attack, you may remain at 1 HP instead. (You must complete a long rest before using this again.)
